title: E-commerce Website Design & Development Services
subtitle: Custom Shopify, WooCommerce, and headless e-commerce stores built to convert — fast checkouts, secure payments, and SEO-ready product pages.

whatIs.title: What Is E-commerce Web Design?
whatIs.p1: E-commerce web design is the process of building an online store that turns visitors into paying customers — combining fast product discovery, a frictionless checkout, and secure payment processing in one experience.
whatIs.p2: We build stores on Shopify and WooCommerce for fast, reliable launches, or fully custom headless storefronts (Next.js/Astro + a commerce API) when performance and unique branding matter most.

storeSetupDesc: New store launches on Shopify or WooCommerce, or migration from an existing platform with every product, category, and customer record mapped over with zero data loss.
customStorefrontsDesc: Headless, fully custom storefronts for brands that need unique UX beyond template themes, decoupling the frontend from the commerce backend for maximum design freedom and speed.

platforms.title: Platforms We Build On
platforms.description: The right platform depends on your catalog size, budget, and growth plans — we'll recommend one rather than push a default.
platforms.shopify: Best for fast, low-maintenance launches with predictable hosting costs.
platforms.woocommerce: Best for stores already invested in WordPress that need deep customization.
platforms.nextHeadless: Best for high-traffic brands that need maximum performance and unique UX.
platforms.astroHeadless: Best for content-heavy stores that want near-instant page loads by default.

rightFor.title: Which Platform Is Right for You?
rightFor.text: If you need to launch quickly with minimal ongoing maintenance, Shopify is usually the right call. If you're already running WordPress or need deep customization of checkout logic, WooCommerce fits better. If your catalog is large, traffic is high, or your brand needs a storefront that doesn't look like every other store on the same platform, a headless build is worth the extra development time. We'll walk through your catalog size, budget, and growth plans in a free consultation and recommend the option that actually fits, not the one that's easiest for us to sell.

faq.q1: Shopify or WooCommerce — which is right for my store?
faq.a1: Shopify suits fast launches with predictable hosting costs and no maintenance overhead. WooCommerce suits stores that need deep customization or are already invested in the WordPress ecosystem. We'll recommend one based on your catalog size and budget.
faq.q2: Can you migrate my existing store without losing SEO rankings?
faq.a2: Yes — we map every existing product/category URL to its new equivalent and set up 301 redirects, preserving your search rankings through the migration.
faq.q3: Do you set up payment gateways and shipping?
faq.a3: Yes, including regional payment gateways, tax rules, and shipping zone configuration as part of every store build.
faq.q4: How long does an e-commerce store take to launch?
faq.a4: A Shopify/WooCommerce store with a standard catalog typically launches in 3-6 weeks; custom headless storefronts take 8-12 weeks depending on scope.
